source_configurations.measurement_qualification: Approximate illustrated mineral-layer thickness; n=3 independent experiments in Fig. 2d, not a recovered tooth/donor-level thickness distribution.
source_configurations.locator: Fig. 2c,d and Results: Remineralization of enamel and dentine

source_configurations.measurement_qualification: Approximate illustrated mineral-layer thickness; n=5 independent experiments in Fig. 2i. Other dentin configurations use a nominal 2 micrometre coating; these are not pooled replicates.

sensitivity_bounds_meaning: Investigator-defined illustrative bounds on a synthetic target, not confidence intervals, segmentation errors, patient data or source uncertainty.

moment_sensitivity.frame: Fixed root/socket reference; x lateral, y transverse, z coronal. Moment is r cross F about the declared origin, not a fitted tooth center of resistance.
